s1.syndrome_frame: Bilateral ocular inflammation with recent onset of blurred vision and ocular irritation, following a systemic illness with fever and arthralgia
salient_findings: Stromal immune ring formation with underlying keratic precipitates
Positive for Chikungunya virus with weak viral load
key_facts: Patient is a teenage girl from Saint-Martin
Presented with bilateral blurred vision and ocular irritation
Experienced fever and severe arthralgia one month earlier
Recently acquired periorbital hyperpigmentation
Ocular history was negative for trauma and previous inflammation
Primary HIV infection, tuberculosis, sarcoidosis, and syphilis had been ruled out
Best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OU
Slitlamp biomicroscopy revealed bilateral punctate superficial keratitis
Aqueous tap PCR results were positive for Chikungunya virus
Aqueous humor was negative for CHIKV-specific immunoglobulins
Positive IgM CHIKV serologic test

shortlist.why_kept: Positive aqueous tap PCR results and positive IgM CHIKV serologic test

shortlist.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral ocular inflammation and presence of keratic precipitates

shortlist.label: Herpes simplex keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral punctate superficial keratitis and stromal immune ring formation

shortlist.why_kept: Recent onset of blurred vision and ocular irritation following a systemic illness

shortlist.label: Toxoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral ocular inflammation and presence of keratic precipitates, although less likely due to negative serology for common causes

raw.rationale: Aqueous tap PCR results were positive for Chikungunya virus and the patient had a recent history of fever and arthralgia, which are common symptoms of Chikungunya virus infection

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: No heterochromia mentioned and the condition typically presents with chronic inflammation

rejected.label: Herpes simplex keratitis
rejected.why: Aqueous tap PCR results were negative for human herpesviruses 1 and 2

rejected.label: Varicella-zoster virus keratitis
rejected.why: Aqueous tap PCR results were negative for varicella-zoster virus

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: No mention of retinochoroiditis or other typical findings of toxoplasmosis
